business_summary: Suzuyo Shinwart Corporation operates as an information services and logistics solutions in Japan. The company provides system solutions, including logistics consulting, HR/payroll/attendance solution, payroll outsourcing, electronic paystub, electronic personnel reporting, electronic annual tax return, financial accounting solution, CMS (content management), digital marketing, workflow/expenses, groupware, and webmail; IT infrastructure, such as data center, bare metal server and private cloud, online storage, S-port telework and remote PC service, S-port X (cross) connect, internet connection service, monitoring/operation/security, pre-driving alcohol check and temperature measurement cloud service, business chat, monitoring and operation/security, pre-operation alcohol check and temperature check cloud service, cloud service to help improve employee engagement, salesforce related solution, web conferencing zoom, reservation system Rizaen, and virtual server (Iaas); and system development solutions comprising system construction and development, network construction, logistics system development, cloud-based inventory and warehouse management systems, and package system. It also offers S-PAYCIAL, a solution for personnel, payroll, and attendance solutions; logistics IT consulting service; S-Port; Asa; BIZ-Oin; and S-Port telework/remote PC services. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
